🌧️💨Weathierest in the (north)West 

(yes not a word, but you get the gist) 

🌧️A rainband moves in from the Tasman, sweeping eastwards across Aotearoa New Zealand.

⛈️Strong gusts can be expected and even some possible thunderstorms. 

Check your full forecast here 👉 www.metservice.com/warnings/home
